grammar_focus: 动词形式综合复习(一般过去 / 过去完成 had done / 被动系表 were astounded 等混合运用),外加逗号的五种常见用法:句首状语后加逗号、同位语用逗号隔开、列举时用逗号、插入语 however 用逗号隔开、非限定性从句用逗号标出(原创承载 NCE3 L19 考点·净化:把'绑架勒索赎金'改写为'猫溜进豪华宠物度假村,主人付巨额账单赎回',保留'dear=心爱+昂贵'的双关与'在可靠的人那里'的桥段,去掉绑架勒索)
scene: 埃莉诺·拉姆齐太太是位很有钱的老太太,多年来一直和她的猫拉斯特斯合住一套公寓。拉斯特斯过着极有规律的日子:每天傍晚出去溜达一小会儿,七点前准回家。可有天傍晚,他没能回来。深爱这只猫的拉姆齐太太急坏了,到处找也找不着。拉斯特斯失踪三天后,邮箱里来了一张精致的卡片,寄自全县最豪华的宠物度假村“胡须庄园”。卡上说:拉斯特斯大概是厌倦了平淡的日子,从花园门溜了进来,住下就当自己是主人;他“在可靠的人那里”,得到悉心照料,拉姆齐太太若想接他回去,只需付清账单。她差点晕过去——那张印在厚厚硬纸板上的账单,足足一千美元。原来这三天里,拉斯特斯天天被梳毛、喂三文鱼,像王室一样被伺候着。拉姆齐太太从银行取出钱,径直开车过去。第二天傍晚,拉斯特斯准时七点晃回了家,吃得圆滚滚、毛发油亮,一副心满意足的样子。她把经过一说,朋友们全惊呆了。她只是笑笑,说拉斯特斯一向是她的心肝宝贝——而想想她付的那笔钱,如今这猫可真是“贵重”得不止一层意思了!

grammar_card.title: 动词形式复习 + 逗号的用法
grammar_card.intro: ①本课把学过的动词时态放在一起复习:一般过去(took / failed)、过去完成 had done(had shared / had wandered)、被动或系表(were astounded)。读时留意每个动词为什么用这种形式。②逗号(comma)常见五种用法:(a)句首状语后加逗号:Three days later, a card arrived. (b)同位语两边加逗号:Mrs. Ramsay, a wealthy old lady, loved her cat. (c)列举各项之间加逗号:milk, bread, and eggs. (d)插入语 however 两边加逗号:The bill, however, was huge. (e)非限定性从句用逗号标出:The cat, which loved salmon, grew plump.

rows: 先说时间/条件,再加逗号
Three days later, a card arrived.
Mrs. Ramsay, a wealthy old lady, …
并列的东西之间加逗号
插入语、非限定性从句用逗号

specialRules.rule: 同位语和插入语(如 however)要用一对逗号把它整段隔开:漏掉任何一个逗号都算错。
非限定性从句(补充信息、可去掉)前后要加逗号;限定性从句(不可去掉)则不加。
美语拼写与用词:apartment(英式 flat)、the mail(英式 post)、vacation(英式 holiday)。本课已按美语写。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why was Rastus 'very dear' in more ways than one?
options: He was both deeply loved and very expensive
He was the oldest cat in town
He was a rare and famous breed

passage: Mrs. Eleanor Ramsay, a very wealthy old lady, had shared her apartment with her cat, Rastus, for a great many years. Rastus led an orderly life. He usually took a short walk in the evenings, and he was always home by seven o'clock. One evening, however, he failed to arrive. Mrs. Ramsay, who loved him dearly, grew very worried. She looked everywhere, but she could not find him. Three days after Rastus's disappearance, a fancy card arrived in the mail. It came from Whisker Manor, the most luxurious pet resort in the county. The note explained that Rastus, tired of his quiet routine, had wandered in through their garden gate and settled down as if he owned the place. He was, the manager wrote, in very safe hands. If Mrs. Ramsay wished to collect him, she had only to pay his bill. At first, she nearly fainted, for the bill, printed neatly on thick cardboard, came to a thousand dollars. The staff, it seemed, had taken considerable pride in brushing him, feeding him salmon, and pampering him like royalty. Mrs. Ramsay withdrew the money from her bank and drove straight over. The next evening, punctually at seven o'clock, Rastus strolled home, looking plump, glossy, and thoroughly pleased with himself. Her friends were astounded when she told them the story. She only smiled and said that Rastus had always been dear to her. Considering the amount she had paid, he was now dear in more ways than one!

grammar_points.name: 动词时态复习(一般过去 / 系表)
动词时态复习(过去完成 had done)
逗号:句首状语后 + 列举
逗号:插入语 however / 非限定性从句

stage5.stem: "Every evening Rastus ___ a short walk and came home by seven."(一般过去)
stage5.stem_cn: 每天傍晚拉斯特斯都去散会儿步,七点前回家。

stage5.stem: "One evening, however, he ___ to arrive on time."(一般过去)
stage5.stem_cn: 可有天傍晚,他没能按时回来。

stage5.stem: "Her friends ___ when she told them the whole story."(一般过去:“感到震惊”)
stage5.stem_cn: 她把整件事一说,朋友们都惊呆了。

stage5.stem: "Mrs. Ramsay ___ her apartment with the cat for many years."(过去完成:此前一直)
stage5.stem_cn: 拉姆齐太太多年来一直和这只猫合住。

stage5.stem: "The note said Rastus ___ in through the garden gate."(过去完成:“早先已溜进”)
stage5.stem_cn: 便条说拉斯特斯早先从花园门溜了进去。

stage5.stem: "Considering the amount she ___, the cat was dear indeed."(过去完成:“已付”)
stage5.stem_cn: 想想她付的那笔钱,这猫可真够“贵”的。

stage5.stem: 下面哪一句在列举东西时,逗号用得正确?
stage5.stem_cn: 列举并列的东西时,各项之间要用逗号分隔。
options: He was brushed, fed, and pampered.
He was brushed fed and, pampered.
He was, brushed fed and pampered.
He, was brushed fed and pampered.

stage5.stem: 下面哪一句在句首的时间状语后,正确地加了逗号?
stage5.stem_cn: 先说时间状语,再用逗号与主句隔开。
options: Three days later, a card arrived.
Three days later a, card arrived.
Three days, later a card arrived.
Three, days later a card arrived.

stage5.stem: 下面哪一句列举时标点用得正确?
stage5.stem_cn: 并列的名词之间用逗号分隔。
options: I bought milk, bread, and eggs.
I bought milk bread, and, eggs.
I bought, milk bread and eggs.
I, bought milk bread and eggs.

stage5.stem: 下面哪一句用逗号正确地隔开了同位语(补充说明)?
stage5.stem_cn: 同位语要用一对逗号前后隔开。
options: Mrs. Ramsay, a wealthy old lady, loved her cat.
Mrs. Ramsay a wealthy old lady, loved her cat.
Mrs. Ramsay, a wealthy old lady loved her cat.
Mrs. Ramsay a wealthy old lady loved her cat.

stage5.stem: 下面哪一句用同位语正确地介绍了这家度假村?
stage5.stem_cn: 同位语两边都要有逗号。
options: Whisker Manor, the finest pet resort, took him in.
Whisker Manor the finest pet resort, took him in.
Whisker Manor, the finest pet resort took him in.
Whisker, Manor the finest pet resort took him in.

stage5.stem: 下面哪一句同位语的标点用得正确?
stage5.stem_cn: 补充说明“她唯一的伙伴”要用一对逗号隔开。
options: Rastus, her only companion, came home at last.
Rastus her only companion, came home at last.
Rastus, her only companion came home at last.
Rastus her only, companion came home at last.

stage5.stem: 下面哪一句用逗号正确地隔开了插入语 however?
stage5.stem_cn: 插入语 however 要用一对逗号前后隔开。
options: There were, however, no cats at home.
There were however, no cats at home.
There, were however no cats at home.
There were however no, cats at home.

stage5.stem: 下面哪一句正确地用逗号标出了非限定性(可去掉的补充)从句?
stage5.stem_cn: 补充信息、可去掉的从句前后要加逗号。
options: The cat, which loved salmon, grew plump.
The cat which loved salmon, grew plump.
The cat, which loved salmon grew plump.
The cat which, loved salmon grew plump.

stage5.stem: 下面哪一句 however 的标点用得正确?
stage5.stem_cn: 插入语 however 两边都要有逗号。

stage5.stem: "A person who has a lot of money is ___."(“富有的”用哪个词)
"To take money out of your bank account is to ___ it."(“取(钱)”用哪个词)
"Arriving exactly on time is arriving ___."(“准时地”用哪个词)
